# Vendored MediaPipe runtime

`vision_bundle.mjs` and `wasm/` come from the
[`@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 0.10.14 tarball](https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-0.10.14.tgz).
They are plugin-owned so this folder does not rely on an undocumented Byte
Edition runtime path.
